definitions: A surname from French, variant of Lagrange.

blocks.text: "La Grange" is a song by the American rock group ZZ Top, from their 1973 album Tres Hombres. One of ZZ Top's most successful songs, it was released as a single in January 1974 and received extensive radio play, rising to No. 41 on the Billboard Hot 100 in June 1974. The song’s title and lyrics refer to a brothel on the outskirts of La Grange, Fayette County, Texas. The brothel is also the subject of the Broadway play and film The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas.
